pedagogical_review.notes: The chapter derives the compiler pipeline, distinguishes legality from cost with one exact executable planner, contrasts loop and SLP behavior, counters sixteen misconceptions, gives ten varied examples through avionics, and ends with five progressive exercises and complete answers.

limitations: Internal authoring, source, mathematical, snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical evidence only; no external C/ISO, IEEE, OpenMP, LLVM, Clang, GCC, Intel, compiler-correctness, ISA/hardware, numerical, security, financial, avionics, regulatory/certification, operations, human-factors, or safety review is claimed. The chapter and planner model establish neither an actual compiler's universal correctness, a generated binary's measured speedup or constant-time behavior, pricing-model validity, airworthiness, regulatory approval, nor deployment safety.
